name: Single Star Chart
description: Coordinates to a lone star beyond the edge of charted space.

name: Close Binary Chart
description: A tight pair of stars locked in a fast orbit around each other.

name: Wide Binary Chart
description: Two stars far apart, each with its own court of worlds.

name: Close Trinary Chart
description: Three stars crowded close together. Their tangled pull scatters wreckage and old caches across the whole system.

name: Mixed Trinary Chart
description: A close pair of stars with a distant third.

name: Wide Trinary Chart
description: Three stars spread wide apart, each a separate prize.

name: The Silent Reach
description: A Domain-era survey record of a binary system that swallows sensor returns whole. Whatever the surveyors found there, they never filed the report.

name: The Warden's Vigil
description: Coordinates lifted from a warden fleet's own navigation core. The crew suspects the vault it guards was never meant to be opened.
